## Ferramenta Fiserv Credito (subworkflow)

Cliente completo do escopo Clover Capital. Chame via Execute Workflow / Tool Workflow.

### Variaveis de ambiente (n8n $env)
- FISERV_BASE_URL (sandbox: https://apidev.moneymoneyinvest.com.br | prod: https://api.moneymoneyinvest.com.br)
- FISERV_EMAIL
- FISERV_PASSWORD

### Entrada: { action, ...campos }
- create_lead: contact_name, contact_phone_number, registration_code(cnpj), revenue, requested_amount; opcional contact_email; opt_in(+opt_in_ip,opt_in_signer_name)
- get_status: loan_request_id
- get_result: cnpj
- simulate: loan_request_id, requested_amount, requested_installments
- confirm: loan_request_id, contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone_number, installments, requested_amount

### Saida
{ ok, action, http_status, error, data, warnings, [loan_request_id|status|external_status|offer_data|simulation_data] }

OBS: o polling temporizado (cadencia 40s) NAO vive aqui. Um poller (schedule/Wait) chama action=get_status e entrega o resultado via outbound.
